commands.name: search-organizations
commands.summary: Search ROR organizations by keyword or advanced field query, with optional filters (type, status, country, continent) and pagination (20 per page)

commands.name: get-search-facets
commands.summary: Get the total match count and facet counts (types, countries, continents, statuses) for a ROR search, without the result items

commands.name: get-organization
commands.summary: Get the full ROR record for one organization by ROR ID: names, locations, external IDs (GRID, ISNI, Wikidata, FundRef), links and parent/child/related relationships

commands.name: match-affiliation
commands.summary: Match a free-text affiliation string (e.g. from a paper's author list) to ROR organizations; returns scored candidates with matching type and a 'chosen' flag for a confident match
